127SI design system

Version 1.3.4. Every colour, font and shared component used by the 127 Sports Intensity platforms, shown in the default theme and in the Team Shot Tracker theme. If something on a live site does not look like this page, the site is wrong.

Brand kit

The official 127 SI brand kit is the highest authority. These five colours, the logos, stamps and patterns come straight from it.

  • --si-blue
  • --si-orange
  • --si-black
  • --si-gray
  • --si-gray-light

All colours

The kit colours plus the Brand System v4 extensions and the text-safe variants this system adds. Blue is primary (buttons, active navigation). Orange is the accent. These never change with the theme.
